inline.headline: Every two years, before the cold.
inline.alt: A gasfitter kneeling at a wall gas heater with its front panel off, testing it before winter

jobs.title: Book the gas heater service
jobs.description: Every two years by a licensed gasfitter, including a carbon monoxide test.
directions: Note the heater's make and model
Book a licensed gasfitter in autumn
Ask for a carbon monoxide test
Keep the service record

jobs.title: Clear plants from the heater flue

end.headline: Warm, and checked.
end.alt: A family under a knitted blanket on the couch on a winter night, a gas heater glowing beside them

jobs.title: Check around the gas heater
jobs.description: A metre clear all round, vents open, no exhaust fans while it runs.
directions: Move furniture and curtains a metre back
Check the wall vents aren't blocked
Look for soot or a changed flame
Keep the rangehood off while it's on

inline.headline: One check, first cold week.
inline.alt: A woman checking the cord where it joins an electric blanket controller, the blanket spread out on the bed

jobs.title: Check the electric blanket
jobs.description: Scorch marks, kinks, frayed cord, then the hot spot test.
directions: Lay the blanket out flat
Look for scorch marks, kinks and lumps
Check the cord and controller
Cover it, run on high, feel for hot spots

end.headline: Cosy, not risky.
end.alt: A couple reading in bed on a cold night under a thick doona, a bedside lamp on

jobs.title: Roll up the electric blanket for summer
jobs.description: Roll it, don't fold it, and store it with nothing on top.
directions: Unplug it and let it cool
Sponge any marks, dry it flat
Roll it loosely, never fold
Store it where nothing sits on top

inline.headline: Move the pile. Book the check.
inline.alt: A man stacking split firewood onto a freestanding steel rack on pavers in the middle of a backyard

jobs.title: Move the woodpile off the house
jobs.description: Off the ground, under cover, away from walls, fences and the shed.
directions: Pick a dry spot well away from the house
Set up a steel rack off the ground
Restack with the oldest wood in front
Check the old spot for mud tubes

end.headline: Dry wood. Happy house.
end.alt: A dad and his daughter carrying split firewood across the backyard on a cold autumn afternoon

jobs.title: Fill the log holder from the rack
jobs.description: Oldest wood first. Tap two pieces together for a hollow crack.
directions: Take wood from the oldest end
Knock two pieces to check they're dry
Fill the metal log holder
Leave the rest under cover

jobs.title: Move the woodpile off the house

inline.headline: Book the sweep in autumn.
inline.alt: A woman shining a torch up into an open brick fireplace to check the chimney for soot

jobs.title: Get the chimney cleaned
jobs.description: Once a year before winter, by a qualified chimney sweep.
directions: Torch check for soot and blockages
Book a sweep in late summer or autumn
Ask them to check for corrosion
Don't light a fire until it's done

jobs.title: Check the fire screen and hearth
Move the woodpile off the house

end.headline: First fire, no worries.
end.alt: A couple with mugs of tea sitting on the floor near an open fire behind a mesh fire screen

jobs.title: Torch check up the chimney
jobs.description: Look for thick soot, tar-like build-up or nests before the first fire.
directions: Wait until the fireplace is cold
Open the damper
Shine a torch up the flue
Book a sweep if there's build-up
